_comment: Asset sources database for media acquisition. Covers court records, government sources, free stock media, archives, music, and educational content.

sources.name: PACER
sources.description: Public Access to Court Electronic Records. Federal court documents, dockets, case files for all federal courts.

sources.name: CourtListener
sources.description: Free legal research platform with millions of legal opinions, PACER documents, and oral argument audio.

sources.name: Sex Offender Registry
sources.description: National Sex Offender Public Website. Search registered sex offenders across all US states and territories.

sources.name: BOP Inmate Locator
sources.description: Federal Bureau of Prisons inmate locator. Find federal inmates incarcerated since 1982. NOTE: Use www.bop.gov/inmateloc — bare domain does not resolve.

sources.name: State DOC Websites
sources.description: State Department of Corrections websites providing inmate search, offender information, and release dates.

sources.name: Mugshots.com
sources.description: Public arrest records and mugshot database aggregated from law enforcement agencies.

sources.name: C-SPAN
sources.description: Congressional hearings, Senate/House proceedings, presidential events, and political speeches. Free to use for non-commercial purposes.

sources.name: DVIDS
sources.description: Defense Visual Information Distribution Service. Military photos and videos from DoD units worldwide, all public domain.

sources.name: White House AV
sources.description: Official White House audio and video including presidential addresses, press briefings, and events.

sources.name: NASA Media
sources.description: NASA's media library with hundreds of thousands of images, videos, and audio files from space missions.

sources.name: US DOD Imagery
sources.description: US Department of Defense official photo and video archive covering military operations worldwide.

sources.name: US Courts
sources.description: Official United States Courts website with court opinions, rules, and educational resources.

sources.name: EU Audiovisual
sources.description: European Commission Audiovisual Services. Photos and videos from EU institutions, freely available.

sources.name: UN Multimedia
sources.description: United Nations Multimedia Library with photos, video, and audio from UN operations and events worldwide.

sources.name: Pexels Video
sources.description: High-quality free stock videos contributed by talented creators. Free for commercial use, no attribution required.

sources.name: Pixabay Video
sources.description: Free stock footage and videos. Content under Pixabay License, free for commercial use without attribution.

sources.name: Videvo
sources.description: Free stock video footage, motion graphics, and free HD & 4K video clips. Mix of free and premium content.

sources.name: Coverr
sources.description: Beautiful free stock video footage for your homepage. All videos are free for commercial use.

sources.name: Mixkit
sources.description: Free stock video clips, music tracks, and sound effects. Mixkit License allows use without attribution.

sources.name: Life of Vids
sources.description: Free stock videos and loops with no copyright restrictions. Free to use for personal and commercial projects.
sources.status_note: SSL certificate invalid or expired as of 2026-03. May still work in browser. Verify before use.

sources.name: Dareful
sources.description: Free 4K stock footage library. High-quality nature, architecture, and urban footage for free use.

sources.name: Mazwai
sources.description: Curated free HD video clips and footage. Creative Commons licensed content for use in projects.

sources.name: Splitshire
sources.description: Free photos and videos for personal and commercial use by photographer Daniel Nanescu. No attribution required.

sources.name: Internet Archive
sources.description: Digital library of millions of free books, movies, software, music, websites, and more. Vast archive of historical media.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons
sources.description: Free media repository with over 80 million freely usable media files. Images, videos, and audio on every topic.

sources.name: Getty Free
sources.description: Getty Images free editorial content including historical news photos and archival imagery for non-commercial use.

sources.name: Storyblocks Free
sources.description: Royalty-free stock footage, images, and audio. Subscription model with a library of free content available.

sources.name: Motion Array Free
sources.description: Motion graphics templates, stock footage, and video effects. Free tier available with select assets.

sources.name: British Pathé
sources.description: Historic newsreel archive with over 100 years of footage covering major world events from 1896-1984. Free to view.

sources.name: Library of Congress
sources.description: Free-to-use media collections from the US Library of Congress including photos, films, maps, and recordings.

sources.name: Prelinger Archives
sources.description: Collection of advertising, educational, industrial, and amateur films from the late 1800s to the 1990s, mostly public domain.

sources.name: Public Domain Review
sources.description: Curated collection of remarkable public domain works including art, literature, and photography. All content is public domain.

sources.name: YouTube Audio Library
sources.description: Free music and sound effects for YouTube creators. Hundreds of royalty-free tracks in every genre.

sources.name: Free Music Archive
sources.description: Interactive library of high-quality, legal audio downloads directed by WFMU radio. Creative Commons licensed music.

sources.name: ccMixter
sources.description: Community music site featuring music licensed under Creative Commons. Find remixable music for your projects.
sources.status_note: SSL certificate invalid or expired as of 2026-03. May still work in browser. Verify before use.

sources.name: Incompetech
sources.description: Royalty-free music by Kevin MacLeod. Free for use with attribution under Creative Commons license.

sources.name: Bensound
sources.description: Royalty-free music for creators. Free tier available with attribution; premium subscription removes attribution requirement.

sources.name: Freesound
sources.description: Collaborative database of Creative Commons-licensed sound effects and audio snippets. Over 500,000 sounds.
sources.status_note: Server timed out during verification (2026-03). May be intermittent. Test before relying on it.

sources.name: Musopen
sources.description: Free classical music recordings, sheet music, and textbooks. All content is public domain or Creative Commons.

sources.name: Pixabay Music
sources.description: Free music for any project. All tracks under Pixabay License, free for commercial use without attribution.

sources.name: ZapSplat
sources.description: Free sound effects and royalty-free music. Over 100,000 free sound effects for personal and commercial use.

sources.name: Pexels Photos
sources.description: Free stock photos shared by talented photographers. All photos free for commercial use, no attribution required.

sources.name: Unsplash
sources.description: Beautiful free images and photos. Over 3 million images contributed by photographers worldwide, free for commercial use.

sources.name: Pixabay Photos
sources.description: Over 2 million free stock photos, illustrations, and vectors. Free for commercial use under Pixabay License.

sources.name: Burst Shopify
sources.description: Free stock photos for entrepreneurs. High-resolution images by Shopify, free for commercial use.

sources.name: StockSnap
sources.description: Hundreds of high-resolution images added weekly. All images are CC0 licensed, free for commercial use.

sources.name: Reshot
sources.description: Unique free stock photos and SVG icons that are free for commercial use without attribution.

sources.name: Kaboompics
sources.description: Free high-quality stock photos with a color palette picker. Free for personal and commercial use.

sources.name: NOAA Library
sources.description: National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration image and media library. Weather, ocean, climate, and earth science imagery.

sources.name: USGS EarthExplorer
sources.description: USGS EarthExplorer: search and download satellite imagery, aerial photography, and cartographic products. All public domain.

sources.name: NIH Image Gallery
sources.description: National Institute of General Medical Sciences — biomedical images and multimedia. Free for educational and informational use. NOTE: old images.nigms.nih.gov subdomain is dead; use www.nigms.nih.gov.

sources.name: ESA Media
sources.description: European Space Agency multimedia gallery. Space imagery, satellite photos, and mission documentation.

sources.name: CDC Public Health
sources.description: CDC Public Health Image Library. Photos, illustrations, and multimedia of public health and disease content.

sources.name: Khan Academy
sources.description: Free educational content across math, science, history, and more. Videos and exercises available under Creative Commons.

sources.name: MIT OpenCourseWare
sources.description: Free MIT course materials online. Lecture notes, video lectures, and course materials under Creative Commons license.
